Trace, implement and test: 2)Greatest Common Divisor of Strings

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
def find_gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

class Solution(object):
    def gcdOfStrings(self, str1, str2):
        """
        :type str1: str
        :type str2: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        max_length = find_gcd(len(str1), len(str2))
        candidate = str1[:max_length]

        # Check if the candidate perfectly reconstructs BOTH strings
        if (candidate * (len(str1) // max_length) == str1 and 
            candidate * (len(str2) // max_length) == str2):
            return candidate
            
        return ""
